text:
tara (PMM): Heads-up: we need a compact solution brief and a short benchmark narrative for enterprise buyers who ask about secure deploys. Focus: SLA behaviors, audit logs/KMS, and predictable throughput. Also want webinar + inbound routing playbook.

nathan (Growth): Audience = CISOs + Platform Leads. Tone: concise, trust-first. Also need a LinkedIn teaser and 20-word elevator line for AEs.

amira (Data): I'll surface 3 bench callouts: p95 latency (hosted vs dedicated), per-token unit cost with caching and batching, and observed failover recovery times. I'll give precise numbers and a one-sentence summary.

jess (Creative): Layout idea for one-pager: left column quick TL;DR + CTA, middle column modes matrix (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), right column bench callouts + trust bullets (SOC2, KMS, audit trails). I'll make 2 visual variants.

tom (SalesOps): Routing logic to implement in HubSpot: tag leads with "deploy_interest" and "security_priority". Suggested mapping: 
```
if security_priority == "high" or deploy_interest in ["VPC","OnPrem"]:
  assign -> EnterpriseAE (notify #sales-enterprise)
elif deploy_interest == "Dedicated":
  assign -> SolutionsAE
else:
  assign -> SDRs
```
This mirrors our SLA readiness gating.

tara (PMM): Webinar structure: 25 min talk (why infra choice matters), 10 min benchmarks & demo, 15 min customer panel + live Q&A. CTA: request priority demo (forms capture deploy_interest + security_priority).

amira (Data): Bench bullets: 
- p95 latency: Hosted 210ms vs Dedicated 88ms (seq 512)
- Per-token cost reduction with batching+cache: ~28%
- Median failover to fallback: 1.5s
Soundbite: "Dedicated capacity cuts p95 latency by more than half while batching and cache lower per-token cost by ~28%."

jess (Creative): Social post draft: "New brief: secure, SLA-backed inference for regulated teams. Hosted, Dedicated, or Private — pick the model that fits your compliance and latency needs. Join our webinar to see benchmarks."

tom (SalesOps): AE playbook draft will include: top 5 security questions, escalation path to infra engineering, standard doc links (SOC2, AWS KMS integration guide), and a checklist for demos (network prep, sample RL prompts).

deploy-bot: Calendar booked for 2026-05-13 09:00 PT. Add speakers by 2812345750.

tara (PMM): Deadlines: one-pager mock Tue EOD, benchmark blurb + chart Wed EOD, webinar landing copy Wed AM. Can team commit?

amira (Data): Yes. I'll upload a csv + PNG for the chart.

jess (Creative): Yes. Need approved logos for customer panel.

nathan (Growth): I'll prepare email cadence and landing page. Will also draft 20-word elevator copy: "Predictable, compliant LLM inference — Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments with audit-ready controls and SLA-backed performance."

tara (PMM): Great. We'll iterate in #marketing-review. Closing thread unless blockers appear. :handshake:
